mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation (user_id, seat_id, start_time, end_time, status, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{seatId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, seat_id, start_time, end_time, status, check_in_time, cancel_time, create_time, update_time FROM reservation WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT id, user_id, seat_id, start_time, end_time, status, check_in_time, cancel_time, create_time, update_time FROM reservation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('reserved', 'checked_in') AND end_time > #{now} ORDER BY start_time ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE reservation SET status = #{status}, check_in_time = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'checked_in' THEN NOW() ELSE check_in_time END, cancel_time = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'cancelled' THEN NOW() ELSE cancel_time END WHERE id = #{id}
